violation_type.title: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §744.2751(5))
violation_type.short_title: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children
violation_type.typical_finding: A complete first aid kit was accessible to children.  First aid kit with supplies and hazardous liquids when ingest may pose a risk to children.  The deficiency was corrected during the inspection when the site director stored the first aid kit in a designated location inaccessible to children.

finding_variants.text: A complete first aid kit was accessible to children.  First aid kit with supplies and hazardous liquids when ingest may pose a risk to children.  The deficiency was corrected during the inspection when the site director stored the first aid kit in a designated location inaccessible to children.

The first aid kit contained medication (Epipen) was observed on a table accessible to children, with a  child seated at the same table.     This was corrected when the first aid kit was removed from the table.
Observed a student holding the first aid kit while the operation conducted a fire drill. The first aid kit had student's medication inside.
First aid kit was observed on the same table where the children were sitting.
First aid kit and medicine box was observed on a blue cart near the cafeteria's doorway     This was corrected when both items were moved to the Custodial closet.
